newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Six gang members killed in Colombian capital.
newsitem.headline: Six gang members killed in Colombian capital.

text.p: Six gang members were killed on Friday in a shootout with police in a working-class district on the southeastern outskirts of Bogota, authorities said.

A Judicial Police spokesman said the victims, all males, were well-known members of a local gang known as "Los Roviros" that has preyed on banks and jewelry stores in the Bogota area and outlying districts of the capital.

The gang was also responsible for multiple car thefts, the spokesman said, adding that the six died in a firefight with police in Soacha, the neighbourhood they are believed to have used as their headquarters.
Four pistols and two hand grenades were stripped off the bodies of the dead.
